mechanism_narrative: The sharp rebound in WORKPLACES from -53.3 to -18.9 and the smaller improvement in TRANSIT imply more weekday foot traffic and commuting spillovers. If that recovery continues, RETAIL_REC should rise over the next four weeks relative to the prior four-week mean.
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES and TRANSIT continue improving for two more weeks but RETAIL_REC does not move above its last-4-week average within 4 weeks, the mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL stays above +10 while WORKPLACES remains below -20, people are still spending more time at home but not returning fully to offices, which suppresses discretionary shopping trips. Under that home-centered regime, RETAIL_REC should fall over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL stays > 10 while WORKPLACES stays < -20 for at least 2 consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL is 10.0 in t-0w and WORKPLACES is -18.9 in t-0w
failure_condition: If the stated residential/workplace regime persists for two weeks and RETAIL_REC rises or holds above the prior 4-week mean, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A renewed drop in TRANSIT below its recent trough signals renewed mobility restrictions or avoidance behavior. That shock reaches retail spending quickly, so RETAIL_REC should weaken within one week after the crossing.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls below -45 after having been above -40 in the prior week
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT is -38.9 in t-0w after -46.1 in t-1w
failure_condition: If TRANSIT crosses back below -45 but RETAIL_REC does not decline within the next 7 days, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A continued rise in GROCERY_PHARM after already elevated readings indicates households are shifting spending toward essentials instead of discretionary venues. That substitution should keep RETAIL_REC below its recent average over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: If GROCERY_PHARM stays elevated or rises further over the next month while RETAIL_REC nevertheless exceeds its last-4-week mean, the mechanism fails.

mechanism_narrative: A short-lived drop in PARKS during winter signals colder outdoor conditions and less leisure travel, which can spill over into lower retail and recreation visits with a lag of roughly two weeks. Under that seasonal pattern, RETAIL_REC should soften next.
candidate_trigger: PARKS falls by at least 5 points week-on-week from a recent local high
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS is -13.0 in t-0w after -5.1 in t-1w
failure_condition: If PARKS drops sharply from a local high but RETAIL_REC rises within two weeks, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When PARKS and GROCERY_PHARM rise together, households are still moving locally for low-risk activities and errands rather than avoiding trips entirely. That mixed-local mobility supports discretionary shopping, so RETAIL_REC should improve over four weeks.
failure_condition: If PARKS and GROCERY_PHARM both trend up for two weeks but RETAIL_REC remains below its prior 4-week mean, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A gap where WORKPLACES rises while TRANSIT does not recover signals partial reopening with persistent transport frictions or commuting avoidance. That mismatch should delay retail recovery and keep RETAIL_REC flat to lower over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES increases by at least 10 points over 2 weeks while TRANSIT remains below -35
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved from -53.3 to -18.9 while TRANSIT stayed at -38.9 in t-0w
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES improves materially but TRANSIT stays depressed and RETAIL_REC still rises within 2 weeks, the mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of falling WORKPLACES and only modest TRANSIT recovery indicates that commuting intensity remains too weak to sustain shopping traffic. If this pattern persists, RETAIL_REC should remain below the previous four-week mean over the next month.
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES stays depressed and TRANSIT only partially recovers but RETAIL_REC moves above its last-4-week average within 4 weeks, the hypothesis is falsified.
